site_description: Edit XML, JSON, TXT, SQL and ZPL side by side, with structure tools and live label previews.
about_body: Edit XML, JSON, TXT, SQL and ZPL in one browser workspace. Files and settings are saved locally and sync across tabs. ZPL previews and image exports send label content to Labelary.
not_found_body: The page you are looking for does not exist or has moved.
error_body: An unexpected error occurred. Try again, or go back to the home page.
sort_order_hint: Listed names go first, in this order. The rest keep their place after them. Drag a row, or use the arrow keys on its handle.
sort_order_empty: No names yet. Add the ones in this file, or type one below.
sort_order_template_set_detail: {count} names. Format the file to apply it.
sort_order_template_empty: {name} has no names to sort by
sort_order_template_invalid: {name} has errors and was not used

sort_order_added_detail: Format the file to apply it.
copy_failed: Could not copy to the clipboard
disk_permission_denied: Not saved: no permission to write to {name}
disk_changed: {name} changed on disk since it was opened here
dynvar_timestamp: The current UNIX timestamp in seconds

close_many_overflow: The files will move to the archive, which keeps only the last {limit}. Some of these files will be permanently deleted.
drop_files: Drop XML, JSON or flat files to open them
welcome_body: Saved in this browser and synced across tabs. <<variables>> stay exactly as written.
highlights_description: Colour tags and keys in the editor and the tree. Saved in this browser.
highlights_absent_description: These highlights have no match in the current file.
highlights_hint_prefix: Put the cursor on a tag or key and press
highlight_no_tag: Put the cursor on a tag or key to highlight it.
zpl_unmark: Stop treating <{name}> as a ZPL label
pin_remove_description: It leaves the pinned fields. You can pin it again from the tag's menu.
rename_description: The name is used for tabs and downloads.
close_description: The file will move to the archive. Only the last 10 deleted files are kept; older files are permanently removed.
defaults_description: Set a value per tag or key name, or @attribute. Apply writes them into the open file. Saved in this browser.
defaults_empty: No default values yet. Add one below, or right-click a tag or key in the editor.
defaults_unchanged: Every value already matches its default.
defaults_confirm_description: These values will be written into the open file. Undo with {mod}Z.

archive_restore_failed: Could not restore the file. It is still in the archive.
archive_delete_failed: Could not archive the file. It is still open.
tree_search_empty: No matching nodes. Try another search.
profile_new_description: Starts with default format settings and no highlights, pins or defaults. The current file switches to it.
profile_clone_description: Copies every setting, highlight, pin and default into a new profile. The current file switches to it.
profile_edit_description: Rename the profile or change its colour.
profile_delete_description: Its format settings, highlights, pins and defaults are deleted. Its files switch to {fallback}.
backup_reminder_never: No backup yet: your files only live in this browser
backup_contents: The file holds everything typed into the workspace, variables included, unencrypted. Keep it somewhere safe.
backup_newer: {name} was made by a newer version of the editor
restore_description: Everything in this browser is replaced by the backup from {date}. A backup of the current workspace downloads first.
restore_failed: Could not restore the backup. Your previous workspace was downloaded.
save_failed_full: Not saved: browser storage is full
save_failed: Not saved: the browser refused to save
var_unset_tooltip: Variable: {name}. No value in this profile.
vars_resolve_none_set: No variables to replace. Without a value: {count}
vars_resolved_partly: Variables replaced: {count}. Left without a value: {unresolved}
vars_confirm_description: These values are written into the file. You can undo it.
variables_description: Values for <<name>> variables in this profile. ⇧⌥V writes them into a new file as is. Saved unencrypted in this browser.
variables_empty: No variables yet. Add one below, or right-click a variable in the editor.
variables_dialog_description: Used in this profile when variables are replaced. Written as is.
share_copy_hint: The file and its profile travel inside the link.
share_copied_detail: Anyone with the link can read the file.
share_description: Everything you include travels inside the link, compressed. Anyone with the link can read it.
share_profile_detail: Format and sort settings · Highlights: {highlights} · Pins: {pins} · Defaults: {defaults}
share_variables_detail: Variables: {count}. Values can hold hosts, accounts or tokens.
share_copied_profile_detail: It carries the profile {name}. Anyone with the link can read it.
share_open_no_variables: Highlights: {highlights} · Pins: {pins} · Defaults: {defaults} · No variable values
share_profile_import: Add it as a new profile
share_profile_import_detail: Your profiles stay as they are.
share_profile_keep_changed: Keeps your settings, which differ from the link's.
share_profile_update_detail: Replaces its settings, highlights, pins and defaults with the link's.
share_profile_update_variables: Replaces its settings, highlights, pins, defaults and variables with the link's.
share_profile_ignore_detail: The link's profile is left out.
share_too_large: This file is too large to share as a link.

share_open_too_large: This share link is too large to open.
changelog_description: New features, improvements and fixes, newest first. Entries are written in English.
paste_description: Choose how to read what you pasted into {name}.

showcase_sync_body: Every change shows up in both, as you type.
showcase_local_body: Files, profiles and settings are saved here. ZPL previews use Labelary.
showcase_compare_body: See what changed, line by line.
showcase_share_body: The file travels inside the link, not on a server.
zpl_use_zpl_size: Render at the size from ^PW and ^LL
zpl_download_hint: Press Enter to download, or type a new name first.
zpl_invalid_size: Enter a size between 0.25 and 30 inches
zpl_render_rate_limited: Labelary's rate limit was reached. Try again in a moment.
zpl_download_zip_hint: {count} labels download together as a zip.
zpl_settings_hint: The label to render on, whatever ^PW or ^LL say.
zpl_empty_preview: Paste ZPL or base64 into the editor to see your label.
pane_close_hint: Its tabs move to the pane beside it
zpl_action_failed: The label action failed. Please try again.
zpl_privacy: ZPL is sent to Labelary to render previews and image exports.
zpl_help_right_aligned_x_is_the_right_en: right-aligned: x is the right end
zpl_help_prints_the_content_as_text_too_: prints the content as text too
Prints the content as text too
zpl_help_the_text_goes_above_the_bars_48: the text goes above the bars
zpl_help_starts_a_label_everything_up_to: Starts a label. Everything up to the next ^XZ describes one label.
zpl_help_ends_the_label_the_printer_prin: Ends the label. The printer prints it when it reads this.
zpl_help_a_comment_a_note_for_people_rea: A comment: a note for people reading the code. Nothing prints.
zpl_help_sets_how_wide_the_label_is_66: Sets how wide the label is.
zpl_help_sets_how_long_tall_the_label_is: Sets how long (tall) the label is.
zpl_help_moves_the_starting_corner_every: Moves the starting corner. Every position after it is measured from this point instead of the label’s top-left corner.
zpl_help_shifts_everything_on_the_label_: Shifts everything on the label left or right.
zpl_help_moves_everything_on_the_label_u: Moves everything on the label up or down.
zpl_help_inverts_the_whole_label_black_p: Inverts the whole label: black prints white and white black.
zpl_help_prints_the_whole_label_right_si: Prints the whole label right side up or upside down.
zpl_help_mirrors_the_whole_label_as_if_s: Mirrors the whole label, as if seen in a mirror.
zpl_help_sets_how_many_copies_of_this_la: Sets how many copies of this label to print.
zpl_help_sets_the_unit_every_size_and_po: Sets the unit every size and position after it is written in. Dots is the usual one.
zpl_help_makes_the_print_darker_or_light: Makes the print darker or lighter on top of the printer’s own setting.
zpl_help_sets_how_dark_the_printer_print: Sets how dark the printer prints, from 0 to 30.
zpl_help_sets_how_fast_the_label_moves_t: Sets how fast the label moves through the printer. Slower is often crisper.
zpl_help_tells_the_printer_how_to_find_w: Tells the printer how to find where one label ends and the next begins.
zpl_help_labels_with_a_black_mark_on_the: labels with a black mark on the back
zpl_help_tells_the_printer_whether_it_pr: Tells the printer whether it prints with a ribbon.
zpl_help_direct_thermal_heat_sensitive_l: direct thermal, heat-sensitive labels without a ribbon
zpl_help_sets_what_the_printer_does_afte: Sets what the printer does after a label: tear off, peel, cut, and so on.
zpl_help_picks_the_character_set_text_is: Picks the character set text is read in. 28 (UTF-8) lets accents and other languages print correctly.
zpl_help_sets_the_default_direction_for_: Sets the default direction for every text and barcode after it, unless they set their own.
zpl_help_sets_the_default_font_and_size_: Sets the default font and size for text after it. Text can still pick its own with ^A.
zpl_help_picks_the_font_and_size_for_the: Picks the font and size for the next text only. The character right after ^A is the font’s name.
zpl_help_picks_a_font_stored_on_the_prin: Picks a font stored on the printer by its file name, for the next text.
zpl_help_wraps_the_next_text_into_a_bloc: Wraps the next text into a block of a set width, over several lines if needed.
zpl_help_lines_after_the_first_are_inden: lines after the first are indented {value0}
zpl_help_lets_the_next_fd_write_special_: Lets the next ^FD write special characters as hex codes, like _0A, after the given marker.
zpl_help_sets_where_the_next_item_goes_i: Sets where the next item goes: its top-left corner, measured from the label’s top-left corner.
zpl_help_sets_where_the_next_item_goes_l: Sets where the next item goes, like ^FO, but measured to the bottom-left of text (where the letters sit).
zpl_help_the_content_of_the_item_the_wor: The content of the item: the words to print, or what the barcode encodes.
zpl_help_like_fd_but_the_content_can_cha: Like ^FD, but the content can change between copies, as in a template.
zpl_help_ends_the_current_item_every_ite: Ends the current item. Every item on the label finishes with ^FS.
zpl_help_prints_this_item_inverted_white: Prints this item inverted: white where it overlaps black. This is how white text on a black bar is made.
zpl_help_gives_the_item_a_number_so_a_te: Gives the item a number so a template can fill in its content later.
zpl_help_places_the_same_item_at_several: Places the same item at several positions.
zpl_help_draws_a_box_make_it_as_thick_as: Draws a box. Make it as thick as it is tall and it becomes a line or a solid bar.
zpl_help_as_wide_as_it_is_thick_233: As wide as it is thick
zpl_help_as_tall_as_it_is_thick_236: As tall as it is thick
zpl_help_draws_a_diagonal_line_across_a_: Draws a diagonal line across a box of the given size.
zpl_help_draws_a_picture_written_out_dot: Draws a picture, written out dot by dot in the code. The long block of letters and numbers is the image.
zpl_help_draws_an_image_saved_on_the_pri: Draws an image saved on the printer earlier.
zpl_help_sets_the_default_bar_size_for_b: Sets the default bar size for barcodes after it. Wider bars make a bigger, easier-to-scan barcode.
zpl_help_wide_bars_are_value0_the_narrow: wide bars are {value0}× the narrow ones
zpl_help_draws_a_code_128_barcode_the_mo: Draws a Code 128 barcode, the most common shipping barcode. The ^FD after it holds the content.
zpl_help_draws_a_code_39_barcode_the_fd_: Draws a Code 39 barcode. The ^FD after it holds the content.
zpl_help_draws_an_ean_13_barcode_used_on: Draws an EAN-13 barcode, used on retail products. The ^FD after it holds the 12 digits.
zpl_help_draws_a_upc_a_barcode_used_on_r: Draws a UPC-A barcode, used on retail products. The ^FD after it holds the 11 digits.
zpl_help_draws_an_ean_8_barcode_the_fd_a: Draws an EAN-8 barcode. The ^FD after it holds the 7 digits.
zpl_help_draws_a_upc_e_barcode_the_fd_af: Draws a UPC-E barcode. The ^FD after it holds the digits.
zpl_help_draws_an_interleaved_2_of_5_bar: Draws an Interleaved 2 of 5 barcode, for digits only. The ^FD after it holds the content.
zpl_help_draws_a_code_93_barcode_the_fd_: Draws a Code 93 barcode. The ^FD after it holds the content.
zpl_help_draws_a_qr_code_in_the_fd_after: Draws a QR code. In the ^FD after it, the first letters (like “QA,”) set its error correction; the rest is the content.
zpl_help_highest_still_scans_when_30_is_: highest: still scans when 30% is damaged
zpl_help_draws_a_data_matrix_code_a_smal: Draws a Data Matrix code, a small square 2D code. The ^FD after it holds the content.
zpl_help_draws_a_pdf417_code_a_stacked_2: Draws a PDF417 code, a stacked 2D barcode often used on IDs. The ^FD after it holds the content.
zpl_help_saves_an_image_in_the_printer_s: Saves an image in the printer’s memory, to draw later with ^XG.
zpl_help_saves_this_label_as_a_template_: Saves this label as a template in the printer, to reuse with ^XF.
zpl_help_loads_a_label_template_saved_ea: Loads a label template saved earlier with ^DF.
zpl_help_cancels_every_label_waiting_to_: Cancels every label waiting to print.
zpl_help_saves_or_loads_something_kept_i: Saves or loads something kept in the printer’s memory, like an image, font or template.
zpl_help_changes_how_the_rest_of_the_lab: Changes how the rest of the label is laid out.
zpl_help_a_printer_setting_it_changes_ho: A printer setting. It changes how the printer behaves, not what is drawn, so the preview skips it.
zpl_help_draws_a_value0_the_fd_after_it_: Draws a {value0}. The ^FD after it holds the content.
zpl_help_unknown_detail: The preview doesn’t know this command. Check its spelling, or whether your printer model has it.
zpl_help_default: Left out, so the printer’s default
